sources.height: vi.wikipedia, Hải đăng Vũng Tàu: a round tower 18 m high; Lighthouse Digest, Vung Tau Light (#4244): "white round tower on dwelling", 59 (ft); OpenStreetMap, way 229301316 (Hải đăng Vũng Tàu), height=18. The owner: from the ground to the top of the dome.
